I never liked how bright the original Retro Furniture was, so I decided to make a more toned down variant with more of a peachy orange~

To install, simply download the (AT) or (CP) version and unzip it into your mods folder.﻿﻿

I also highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] alongside the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version to make it easier to view and change items!
